description: Source code for Wi-Fi Access Point RSSI monitoring, including initialization, history management, and event handling functions.

methods.name: timeHandler
methods.description: Periodic handler updating RSSI statistics and notifying changes.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables RSSI monitoring based on SSID status.

methods.name: wld_ap_rssiMonInit
methods.description: Initializes RSSI monitor for an access point, setting parameters and starting monitoring.

methods.name: wld_ap_rssiMonDestroy
methods.description: Destroys RSSI monitor for an access point.

methods.name: s_setApRssiEventing_ocf
methods.description: Handles updates to RSSI eventing configuration via OCF.

methods.name: wld_ap_rssiEv_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information for RSSI eventing.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_createStaHistory
methods.description: Creates history buffer for a station.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_destroyStaHistory
methods.description: Destroys history buffer for a station.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_cleanStaHistory
methods.description: Resets station history data.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_cleanStaHistorySamples
methods.description: Clears station history samples.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateHistoryLen
methods.description: Updates history buffer length for all stations.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getOldestStaSample
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest sample for a station.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getStaSampleIndexed
methods.description: Retrieves a specific indexed sample for a station.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getStaHistory
methods.description: Retrieves full history for a station.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_sendHistoryOnAssocEvent
methods.description: Sends station history upon association event.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_sendHistoryOnDisassocEvent
methods.description: Sends station history upon disassociation event.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_sendStaHistoryAll
methods.description: Sends history for all stations periodically.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateStaHistory
methods.description: Updates history for a specific station.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateStaHistoryAll
methods.description: Updates history for all stations.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getMinMaxSignal
methods.description: Calculates min/max signal, noise, and SNR for a station.
